reusableChecklist: 1. Pixel access: confirm actual pixels delivered (dimensions, encoding, any downsampling) before any claim; hash/decode is not seeing.
2. Sides: label every sided feature as image-side AND character-side; never write bare 'left/right'.
3. Literal details: describe only resolved features; if a detail (tongue, closure, ring count) cannot be resolved, withdraw it rather than approximate.
4. Uncertainty: separate visible absence, occlusion/crop and scale-limited uncertainty; keep confidence labels on lettering and jewelry.
5. Scope: observations only — no ratings, gold declarations, symbolism, production passes or motion claims.
6. Provenance: record input paths/hashes, tool/surface, regions viewed, elapsed time; preserve prior versions, corrections as new versions.
